title: The Locked Library
intro: You wake up on a cold wooden floor. Dusty shelves rise around you, a single lamp flickers on an oak desk and the heavy library door is shut tight, a keypad glowing beside it. Somebody has locked you inside **The Locked Library**. Find a way out.
room_description: A small, dusty library. You can see an oak desk with a drawer, a tall bookshelf, a glass cabinet, a painting of a lighthouse and a heavy door with a keypad.

desk.name: oak desk
desk.description: A heavy oak desk with a brass lamp. A note is pinned to it: "Only the red ones tell the truth." The desk has a single drawer.

bookshelf.name: bookshelf
bookshelf.description: Rows of brown and green leather books. Four books with bright red spines stand out.

red_books.name: red books
red_books.description: You open the four red books one by one. On the first page of each, someone has written a single digit. From left to right they read 7, 2, 9, 4.

drawer.name: desk drawer
drawer.description_locked: The drawer is held shut by a small 4-digit combination lock.

cabinet.name: glass cabinet
cabinet.description_locked: A glass display cabinet with a brass keyhole. Something small sits on the shelf inside.

painting.name: painting
painting.description: An oil painting of a lighthouse on a stormy coast. The varnish looks oddly uneven, as if something was painted over in invisible ink.

use_reveal.text: Under the violet light, glowing numbers appear across the sky of the painting: 3 8 5 9.

door.name: door
door.description_locked: A heavy oak door. A 4-digit keypad glows red beside the handle.
door.description_unlocked: The door stands open. Fresh air flows in.

brass_key.name: brass key
brass_key.description: A small, slightly tarnished brass key.

uv_torch.name: UV torch
uv_torch.description: A small torch that emits violet ultraviolet light.

clues.drawer_code: The red books show the digits 7, 2, 9, 4.
clues.door_code: The painting shows the glowing numbers 3, 8, 5, 9.

hints.text: The note on the desk says only the red ones tell the truth. Look closely at the bookshelf.
The red books gave you four digits. The drawer has a 4-digit lock.
The drawer is open. Is there anything inside worth taking?
A brass key... and there is a cabinet with a brass keyhole.
Something is sitting inside the open cabinet.
The painting's varnish looks strange. Maybe a special light would show more.
You have the numbers from the painting. Try them on the door keypad.
